Migration 0063 adds one pending scheduled-publish slot to app.pages: scheduled_version int4, scheduled_gray_percent int2, scheduled_at timestamptz, scheduled_by_admin_id uuid, all nullable without defaults; pages_scheduled_check (all four null, or all four set with gray 1..100); pages_scheduled_version_fkey (app_id, page_key, scheduled_version) -> page_versions and pages_scheduled_by_admin_id_fkey -> admin_users, no cascade; column UPDATE on the four columns to couli_app; no index. Additive, old rows all NULL. The F1-09a frozen db tests (pages/kit.ts, schema.int.test.ts) gained the new columns, constraint and foreign keys only (ledger test_paths #1077, F1-02q precedent); Codex rule tests got a prettier-only mechanical commit. Migration number taken at landing (D10-116, migration slot). Snapshot regenerated on the test machine. Full verification by the required CI checks (ops/approvals.yaml id 21).
